description: x = 0: gradient g / (2 · sqrt(x)) = ±inf (sign of g); x < 0 gives NaN.

notes: The gradients follow graph-ir.md §3.1.11's convention here (checked by the generator): sqrt'(0) = g / (2 · sqrt(0)), +inf for g > 0. x = -0 is left out: there PyTorch gives -inf for g > 0 (the formula with sqrt(-0) = -0), which graph-ir.md's "+inf for g > 0" doesn't cover. Expected values are PyTorch's (autograd) in f64 on the f32 tensors, rounded once to f32; PyTorch's own f32 result meets tolerance and gradient_tolerance (checked by the generator).
